source: Ubuntu 26.04 desktop amd64 ISO 20260423.1 dependency graph (1814 debs, 12369 edges)

method.filter: metadata-matched; required in-degree >= 5; required out-degree targets >= 3; not oldlibs; not required/important/standard base library
method.score: 0.40*F(required fan-in) + 0.35*L(required out-degree) + 0.25*S(total out-degree & optional share), log-normalized, times priority factor (required 0.60 / important 0.80 / standard 0.90 / optional-extra 1.00)
method.note: Scores rank candidate priority only; they do not assert code quality or known defects. libc6/libgcc-s1/libstdc++6 are excluded as base libraries.

directions.1: mid-layer UI/media infrastructure with high reuse and a wide required-dependency surface (interface stability, plugin split, optional-feature isolation, duplicate dependency convergence)
directions.2: high-level desktop/system components with a wide direct dependency surface (module split, startup path, optional dependencies, feature boundaries)

pilot.reason: not in the top-30 ranking, chosen as the pipeline pilot: small surface, hard ABI contract, measurable micro + browser-render end-to-end path; the flow must certify a real speedup here before fanning out to ranked candidates
